title: Priority and who asked (T2580, T2583)
description: Defs the card and its actions reference: the card's lane and the higher Backlog card a Start would jump.

lane.description: Who asked for the work the run starts with (repotask/lane.py): kuhy, the board itself, or other apps' error reports (always low priority). Backlog sorts kuhy first at equal priority.

waits.description: start only (T2583): a Backlog card of higher priority waits; the page and the app ask 'start anyway?' in a modal before the click goes out. The highest such card is named.
